_comment: Hand-verified expected outputs for the golden_run.json fixture (issue #577). Regenerate ONLY after an intentional formula change using scripts/regen_golden.py. A second engineer must manually verify new values before merging. See docs/REGENERATING_GOLDEN.md for the full regeneration workflow.

normalized_power.formula_note: 30-second rolling mean of power, raised to the 4th power, averaged, then 4th-root taken. Standard Coggan NP algorithm. Version tag updated when the algorithm changes.
normalized_power.tolerance_note: Absolute tolerance of ±0.01 W on the rounded integer result. Since the result is always an integer, the effective tolerance is exact equality.
normalized_power.final_value_tolerance_note: ±0.1% relative tolerance on the unrounded final_value.

tss.tolerance_note: Exact integer equality — TSS rounds to a whole number.
tss.verification_note: Hand-verified against compute_running_tss with ftp_w=280, NP=268 (from streams), duration=2700s. IF=268/280=0.9571, TSS=round(0.75*0.9571^2*100)=69.

detected_profile.verification_note: Hand-verified against detect_session_profile (issue #587): 3 manual laps with ftp_w=280. Lap 1 (avg_power=225, ratio=0.80) -> steady -> Warm-up. Lap 2 (avg_power=265, ratio=0.95) -> tempo -> Tempo (900s >= 480s threshold). Lap 3 (avg_power=298, ratio=1.06) -> hard -> generic label 'hard'. No alternating interval cycles found.

strength_per_set._comment: Hand-verified strength TSS fixture using per_set method (issue #594). Three sets: 5×RPE8, 5×RPE9, 3×RPE10. raw_sum=10.25, scaled=59.9625, tss=60.

strength_session_rpe._comment: Hand-verified strength TSS fixture using session_rpe method (issue #594). 45 min at session RPE=8. IF=0.8, raw_tss=48.0, tss=48.
